name: Hanare Shimaki
source:
One of the protagonist’s juniors who’s taciturn and collected. Has a brusque attitude and tends to avoid interacting with others due to his marked character. He’s often found alone on the rooftop or in other unfrequented places. Because of this, Donzaburo worries a great deal about him. Doesn’t seem to partake in any clubs, but might have some kind of issues with school life itself.

‘…That so? Not that I care, so can you just stop with the small talk?’
‘I see you too have your own eccentricities... Well, I guess it’s alright, as long as you don’t get in my way…’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
